terms.name: Note
terms.definition: a short text kept by the service

examples:
Feature: Notes
  Rule: R-1
    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: Keep
      Given a note
  Rule: R-2
    @R-2 @E-2
    Scenario: List
      Given notes
contract:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Notes
  version: '1'
paths:
  /notes:
    get:
      operationId: listNotes
      x-rules: [R-2]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The notes.
    post:
      operationId: keepNote
      x-rules: [R-1]
      responses:
        '201':
          description: The note was kept.
